title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $100 on the iRobot Roomba Plus 575 Robot Vacuum & Mop Combo
excerpt: Tired of cleaning your floors? It's time to 'hire' a robot.
content_html:
SAVE $100: As of Aug. 27, get the iRobot Roomba Plus 575 Robot Vacuum & Mop Combo for $699.99 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $799.99. That's a discount of 13%.

Credit: Amazon

$699.99 at Amazon
$799.99 Save $100

Whether you have kids or pets or you simply exist in your home, it can feel like a never-ending battle to keep the carpets and floors clean. Dirt is going to magically appear, and you're going to have to get rid of it somehow. That might mean vacuuming the carpets or mopping the floors. Why do it manually when you can assign the task to a robot vacuum-and-mop combo?

There's an especially great option on sale right now at Amazon that can help you accomplish more while a robot automates your cleaning schedule. As of Aug. 27, get the iRobot Roomba Plus 575 Robot Vacuum & Mop Combo for $699.99 at Amazon, down from its usual price of $799.99. That's $100 off, a 13% discount.

This combo unit boasts a strong 25,000Pa suction level, so it can tackle ground-in dirt and debris as well as hair from both humans and pets. It can also fit under furniture and in hard-to-reach areas thanks to its slim chassis, which lets it swoop into smaller spaces to get more cleaning done. It can climb over thresholds up to 35mm and uses automatic mapping to determine where it needs to clean in your home. That takes you out of the equation, so all you have to do is set it up and watch it go.

When it's time to mop, it uses SmartScrub and DualClean mop pads to exert extra pressure to remove tough stains and dried spills. Plus, its spinning mop pads clean with an articulating arm that can extend 35mm to give you better edge coverage. When everything's clean, and the reservoir needs to be emptied and the mop pads cleaned, the dock has you covered as well, with automatic refills and cleaning so you never have to touch a dirty mop pad.
